WritingStyle.title: Writing style
WritingStyle.body: How TILL writes for you: the style profile, learned from your sent mail on this machine, and the choice of local language model. What is stored is what was learned, never a copy of your mail. Without a local runtime installed the page says so openly, and no cloud model is used instead. New models arrive with updates, never through an online check.
